subject: Onsite training — contingency: client travel hold & venue change
messages:
From: Samantha Lowe <samantha.lowe@onyxfinancial.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Trevor Mills <trevor.mills@onyxfinancial.com>, Onyx Financial Events <events@onyxfinancial.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood onsite training — week of Jun 7 (logistics)

Hi Karthik / Marissa,

Quick heads up — travel for our execs is on hold while the CitiTech board finalizes a last-minute portfolio review. That means our planned onsite training for Jun 8 is at risk. We expect a decision by Monday, but I wanted to let you know now so you don't book non-refundable travel.

Two asks: can you hold June 21–25 as backup dates? Also, can you confirm if the trainer can do a half-day executive briefing followed by the hands-on workshop on the same day if we end up compressing the schedule?

I attached the flight itinerary we have so far. I know this is short notice — sorry for the churn.

Thanks,
Samantha
Samantha Lowe
Head of Platform Integrations, Onyx Financial
phone: +1 415-555-0192

Attachment: client-flight-itinerary.png
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lowe <samantha.lowe@onyxfinancial.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood onsite training — week of Jun 7 (logistics)

Hi Samantha — thanks for the flag. Appreciate the early note.

We can absolutely hold Jun 21–25 as a backup; I've blocked tentative travel and kept hotel options refundable through June 15. Trainer flexibility: Dev confirms he can run a 90–120 minute executive briefing + a condensed 4-hour hands-on session in the same day, or split across two half-days. If you think compressing to a single day is likely, we'll prepare a compressed agenda and lab plan.

Next steps from our side:
- I'll attach an updated onsite runbook and venue confirmation for your events team.
- Marissa will confirm room layout options (the trainer likes classroom + two breakout tables).
- If you cancel by Monday, we won't finalize any non-refundable bookings.

I'll wait for the board decision and will stand by to adjust.

Best,
Karthik
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Attachments: onsite-runbook-v2.pdf, venue-confirmation.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 31 May 2026 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood onsite training — week of Jun 7 (logistics)

On Mon, May 31, 2026 at 11:03 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Samantha — thanks for the flag. Appreciate the early note.
> 
> We can absolutely hold Jun 21–25 as a backup...

Thanks team — quick note from events: the downtown venue has a smaller boardroom available Jun 8 if your execs can do an abbreviated morning session; otherwise we should shift to the backup week. The larger training room at our preferred hotel is available Jun 22–24 (I can keep it on hold through Jun 10).

If Onyx wants to keep momentum and avoid two full travel cycles, we can also do a hybrid option: execs join a 90-min executive briefing remotely on Jun 8 and the hands-on lab in-person Jun 22. That would minimize travel for leadership while keeping engineers on-site.

Marissa
Sr. Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Samantha Lowe <samantha.lowe@onyxfinancial.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Trevor Mills <trevor.mills@onyxfinancial.com>, Onyx Financial Events <events@onyxfinancial.com>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood onsite training — week of Jun 7 (logistics)

Thanks for the options and for being flexible. The board decided to compress the review and they want leadership in NY that week — we need to pause all non-essential travel for the team.

Let's do this: please cancel any tentative non-refundable bookings for Jun 8. We'd like to plan for the hybrid approach you proposed: remote exec briefing on Jun 8 (90 minutes) and in-person hands-on Jun 22 (aiming for full day). Can you send a proposed condensed agenda for Jun 8 and lock Jun 22 for the training room? I'll confirm final attendee list Monday and share any dietary restrictions.

Appreciate the quick work here — we know this is last-minute.

Samantha
